title: A Survey of Useful LLM Evaluation

bias_targets.target: Social and Demographic bias (including Gender, Racial, and Religious bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing diverse fairness benchmarks such as BBQ, BIAS, and FaiRLLM that utilize question sets, behavior-based statistical tests, and recommendation scenarios to evaluate structural and social biases against protected classes and sensitive user attributes.
Surveying the Media Bias Identification Benchmark (MBIB), a comprehensive framework that integrates various types of media biases to evaluate and enhance detection techniques in media content.
Reviewing the MERS metric, which assesses machine-generated text across multiple dimensions to specifically target and reduce evaluation biases that favor incorrect factual content.
Reviewing financial sector benchmarking evaluations to identify significant discrepancies in performance metrics caused by timing differences in benchmark composition.
